shelfDescription: Solid Southern yellow pine with natural grain, knots, and individuality. Offered in a range of lengths, customization available upon request.
story: We gather things that catch our eye. Some are made by hand, some are discovered along the way, and all are chosen with curiosity. Rooted in Louisiana, The Bayou Crow is a little Southern charm, a good amount of peculiarity, and a collection that never stays quite the same.
contactText: Interested in an item or a custom shelf? Come see us at An Art Studio in Mandeville or reach out on Facebook to ask about availability and ordering.
